description: Explains why partial matching is an assignment with an exact copied-graph reduction, both decode directions, real-valued dual feasibility, tightness, the smaller-side starting deficit, and the precise claimed rectangular augmentation cost.

related_resources.reason: Pinned arXiv v4, Section 4, Algorithm 2, Lemmas 5 and 6, and the exact matching source crosswalk.

learning_objectives: Construct the copied bipartite graph, explain allowed identity edges and why a maximum partial matching becomes a maximum perfect assignment
Prove the doubling bound by decoding both projections and extending a partial optimum
Prove the dual bound, explain tightness, and calculate the initial smaller-side assignment deficit
Derive Lemma 5 complexity under the paper augmentation model and locate the proved Lean subclaims and open source-cost boundary
